title: Adreno 6XX crash in `_swap_chain_release()`
body:
### Tested versions

- Using standard Android export templates for Godot 4.5.1 stable.

### System information

Godot v4.5.1 stable - Vulkan (Mobile) - Various Android and mobile versions (see details)

### Issue description

After releasing our game Rift Riff to Google Play store (using Godot 4.5.1 stable and the standard export presets), we've been seeing a 4.19% user-perceived crash rate which falls into the Bad Behaviour threshold being above the generally accepted 1.09%. I have taken our top 4 issues (in order of most to least occurrences) and made separate issues for each of them

Each issue includes:
- 5 example crash logs: Both original and the symbolicated Result. We symbolicated the logs after the fact using the Godot_native_debug_symbols.4.5.1.stable.template_release.android and the [ndk-stack](https://developer.android.com/ndk/guides/ndk-stack) methodology
- The crash headline details from Google Console
- The device information from the 5 log examples: Device model, System on Chip, CPU and GPU.

Hopefully this is helpful - please let me know if any other information is needed!
I'll edit these posts with the links to all the other issues to keep them grouped.

- Crash 4:
    - Crashes on LocalVector::operator[]()
    - **[split_config.arm64_v8a.apk!libgodot_android.so]**
    - SIGTRAP
    - 13 Events
    - Occurred across 13 different device types.
    - Device List:
        1. Moto G42
            - QTI SM6225
            - 4x ARM Cortex-A73 (2400 MHz), 4x ARM Cortex-A53 (1900 MHz)
            - Qualcomm Adreno 610 (1115 MHz)
        2. Redmi Note 12 Pro
            1. Qualcomm SM7150
            2. 2x Qualcomm Kryo 470 (2200 MHz), 6x Qualcomm Kryo 470 (1800 MHz)
            3. Qualcomm Adreno 618 (700 MHz)
        3. **moto g85 5G**
            1. QTI SM6375
            2. 2x ARM Cortex-A78 (2200 MHz), 6x ARM Cortex-A55 (1804 MHz)
            3. Qualcomm Adreno 619 (840 MHz)
        4. **OPPO Reno7**
            1. QTI SM6225
            2. 4x ARM Cortex-A73 (2400 MHz), 4x ARM Cortex-A53 (1900 MHz)
            3. Qualcomm Adreno 610 (1115 MHz)
        5. **OPPO CPH2223**
            1. Qualcomm SM6115
            2. 4x Qualcomm Kryo 260 (2000 MHz), 4x Qualcomm Kryo 260 (1800 MHz)
            3. Qualcomm Adreno 610 (950 MHz)
  
My observations:

- Most common issue: ` LocalVector<unsigned int, unsigned int, false, false>::operator[](unsigned int)/root/godot/./core/templates/local_vector.h:201:3
RenderingDeviceDriverVulkan::_swap_chain_release(RenderingDeviceDriverVulkan::SwapChain*)/root/godot/drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:3029:69`
- Majority of devices seem to have Qualcomm Adreno 600 series GPUs, with 3 examples of Qualcomm Adreno 700 series
- I should note that each log threw 2 warnings about lines not being able to be symbolicated, but they were usually quite far down the stack trace (in some cases being 07 and 09, and in other logs being 12 and 21)

Other Android issues with RiftRiff:
- [Crash 1 - LocalVector::size()](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112157)
- [Crash 1b - vulkan.adreno.so / RenderingDeviceGraph::_run_draw_list_command](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112158)
- [Crash 3 -  RenderingDeviceDriverVulkan::_release_image_semaphore()](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112160)
